description: Read a company's own website now and return what it publishes: contact emails, a phone number, its social profiles and its detected tech stack. robots.txt is obeyed. One enrichment credit, charged only when the site publishes a way to reach the company, and at most once per company per day.

domain.description: Company website domain, e.g. acme.com (a full URL is accepted and reduced to its domain)

name: reveal_company_contacts
